identity: Mono-black Void midrange. Alpharael, Stonechosen halves the opponent's life every time it attacks with Void active, and — corrected during the Phase 9 grill — that alone is lethal: from 20 life the remainders run 10, 5, 2, 1, 0 across five Void-active attacks, because at 1 life 'loses half their life, rounded up' takes the last point. The drain suite is therefore an accelerant rather than a mathematical necessity: Entropic Battlecruiser at a single charge counter converts each of the deck's four forced discards into 3 life loss, Decode Transmissions deals 2 with Void live, Dubious Delicacy deals 3 on demand, and Susurian Voidborn drains 1 per death. What makes any of it consistent is Timeline Culler, which can be re-warped from the graveyard for {B} and 2 life, so Void is effectively a repeatable mana ability rather than a condition the deck has to hope for.

sideboard.name: Dauntless Scrapbot
sideboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, exile each opponent's graveyard. Create a Lander token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.")
sideboard.when_to_board: vs graveyard decks (31 cube cards / 12.5% density). 'When this creature enters, exile each opponent's graveyard. Create a Lander token.' It is the ONLY graveyard-hate card in the entire 276-card cube, and it is one-sided, so it does not cost this deck Timeline Culler's own graveyard warp.

sideboard.name: Thaumaton Torpedo
sideboard.oracle_text: {6}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Destroy target nonland permanent. This ability costs {3} less to activate if you attacked with a Spacecraft this turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs enchantments (16 cube cards) and the 52 non-Spacecraft artifacts. '{6}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Destroy target nonland permanent.' Note the {3} discount requires attacking with a Spacecraft, which this build's Battlecruiser cannot do below 8 counters — board it in knowing the real cost is {1} to cast plus {6} to activate. Black has ZERO other answers to the class.

sideboard.name: Scrounge for Eternity
sideboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice an artifact or creature.
Return target creature or Spacecraft card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Then create a Lander token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.")
sideboard.when_to_board: vs decks that answer Alpharael on sight. 'Return target creature or Spacecraft card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield' — Alpharael is mana value 5 and the Battlecruiser is 4, so it redeploys either payoff, and its sacrifice cost turns Void on the same turn.

sideboard.name: Hullcarver
sideboard.when_to_board: vs fast clocks. '{B} Deathtouch' 1/1 — the only one-mana creature in mono-black, so it blocks on turn 2 while the deck sets up, and deathtouch trades with anything in a cube whose evasion class is 56 cards. It is also an Artifact Creature, so its death triggers Susurian Voidborn and it feeds Embrace Oblivion's sacrifice cost.

sideboard.name: Depressurize
sideboard.oracle_text: Target creature gets -3/-0 until end of turn. Then if that creature's power is 0 or less, destroy it.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs go-wide and cheap aggressive starts. 'Target creature gets -3/-0 until end of turn. Then if that creature's power is 0 or less, destroy it.' — kills 104 of the pool's 139 creatures at instant speed for {1}{B}.

identity_es: Midrange Void mono negro. Alpharael, Stonechosen reduce a la mitad la vida del rival cada vez que ataca con Void activo y, corregido durante la revisión de la Fase 9, eso solo ya es letal: desde 20 vidas los restos van 10, 5, 2, 1, 0 a lo largo de cinco ataques con Void activo, porque a 1 vida 'loses half their life, rounded up' se lleva el último punto. El paquete de drenaje es por tanto un acelerante y no una necesidad matemática: Entropic Battlecruiser con un solo contador de carga convierte cada uno de los cuatro descartes forzados del mazo en 3 de pérdida de vida, Decode Transmissions hace 2 con Void activo, Dubious Delicacy hace 3 a demanda, y Susurian Voidborn drena 1 por muerte. Lo que hace consistente todo esto es Timeline Culler, a la que se puede volver a aplicar warp desde el cementerio por {B} y 2 vidas, así que Void es efectivamente una habilidad de maná repetible y no una condición que el mazo tenga que esperar.
